intro.title: About AI2X
intro.description: AI2X is an innovative team of university students focused on technology and artificial intelligence. We represent our country in national and international competitions by developing projects in autonomous systems, artificial intelligence, and robotics. Our team consists of students from different engineering disciplines and produces solutions to complex problems through interdisciplinary work.
